prompt: Design a highly creative voxel art scene depicting an intricate ship sailing inside a bottle. Include realistic waves and physics effects, contained within the bottle. Enrich the scene with colorful voxels, physics simulation, and props/landscapes. Implement via WebGL and other libraries, ensuring it can be copied into a single HTML file and opened in Chrome.

summary: Comparison test between Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon generating a voxel art ship-in-a-bottle WebGL simulation.
summaryEn: Voxel Ship in a Bottle WebGL Scene

post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Argon vs Claude Opus 5.5测试对比！

分别花费：$0.19 vs $12.06

64倍差价的秘密，或许就藏在那几行提示词里。
https://t.co/6Jfuk0FD5C

Opus直接整了个完整的小世界：海豚、海鸥、灯塔、瓶子摇晃，还有一堆交互细节。玻璃、水、小细节都精致得多

Gemini花$0.19也能看，就是简单点。便宜64倍啊

用的提示词：
'设计一个创意十足的体素艺术场景，画一艘精致的船在瓶子里航行。加上逼真的波浪和物理效果，整个场景都装在瓶子里。用多彩的体素、物理模拟和各种道具/景观丰富场景。用WebGL和其他库实现，确保能复制到单个HTML文件里用Chrome打开'
